verses.hebrew: בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל פָּאֲרוּ אֱלֹהִים; בִּקְהַל־רַבִּים הַשְׁמִיעוּ תִפְאַרְתּוֹ׃
verses.english: With a loud voice glorify God, in the congregation of the many proclaim His majesty.

verses.hebrew: בְּרֹב־יְשָׁרִים פָּאֲרוּ שְׁמוֹ; וְעִם־אֵמוּנִים סַפְּרוּ גְדוֹלָתוֹ׃
verses.english: In the multitude of the upright glorify His name, and with the faithful recount His greatness.

verses.hebrew: חַבְּרוּ לַטּוֹבִים נַפְשׁוֹתֵיכֶם; וְלַתְּמִימִים לְפָאֵר עֶלְיוֹן׃
verses.english: Bind your souls to the good ones, and to the pure ones to glorify the Most High.

verses.hebrew: הַחְבִּירוּ יַחַד לְהוֹדִיעַ יִשְׁעוֹ; וְאַל־תִּתְעַצְּלוּ לְהוֹדִיעַ עֻזּוֹ וְתִּפְאַרְתּוֹ לְכׇל־פְּתָאִים׃
verses.english: Form an assembly to proclaim His salvation, and be not lax in making known His might and His majesty to all simple folk.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לְהוֹדִיעַ כְּבוֹד יהוה; נִתְּנָה חׇכְמָה׃
verses.english: For to make known the glory of the LORD is Wisdom given.

verses.hebrew: וּלְסָפֵּר רֹב־מַעֲשָׂיו; נוֹדְעָה לְאָדָם׃
verses.english: And for recounting His many deeds She was revealed to men.

verses.hebrew: לְהוֹדִיעַ לִפְתָאִים עֻזּוֹ; לְהַשְׂכִיל לְחָסְרֵי־לֵבָב גְּדוֹלָתוֹ׃
verses.english: To make known to the simple folk His might, and to explain to senseless folk His greatness.

verses.hebrew: הָרְחוֹקִים מִפִּתְחֶיהָ; הַנִּדָּחִים מִמְּבוֹאוֹתֶיהָ׃
verses.english: Those far from Her gates, those who stray from Her portals.

verses.hebrew: כִּי עֶלְיוֹן הוּא אָדוֹן יַעֲקֹב; וְתִפְאַרְתּוֹ עַל־כׇּל־מַעֲשָׂיו׃
verses.english: For the Most High is the Lord of Jacob, and His majesty is over all His works.

verses.hebrew: וְאָדָם מְפָאֵר עֶלְיוֹן; יְרַצֶּה כְּמַגִּישׁ מִנְחָה׃
verses.english: And a man who glorifies the Most High, He accepts as one who brings a meal-offering.

verses.hebrew: כְּמַקְרִיב עַתּוּדִים וּבְנֵי־בָּקָר; כִּמְדַשֵּׁן מִזְבֵחַ בְּרֹב־עוֹלוֹת; כִּקְטוֹרֶת נִיחוֹחַ מִיָּד־צַדִּיקִים׃
verses.english: As one who offers he-goats and bullocks; as one who fattens the altar with many burnt offerings; as with a sweet-smelling fragrance from the hand of the righteous.

verses.hebrew: מִפִּתְחֵי צַדִּיקִים נִשְׁמְעָה קוֹלָהּ; וּמִקְּהַל־חֲסִידִים זִמְרָתָהּ׃
verses.english: From the gates of the righteous Her voice is heard, and from the assembly of the pious Her song.

verses.hebrew: עַל־אוֹכְלִים בְּשֹׂבַע נֶאֶמְרָה; וְעַל שָׁתֹתִים בְּחֶבֶר יְחִידָיו׃
verses.english: When they eat with satiety She is cited, and when they drink in a community together.

verses.hebrew: שִׂיחָתָם בְּתוֹרָת עֶלְיוֹן; אָמְרֵיהֶם לְהוֹדִיעַ עֻזּוֹ׃
verses.english: Their meditation is on the Law of the Most High, their words on making known His might.

verses.hebrew: כַּמָּה רְחֹקָה מֵרְשָׁעִים אוֹמְרָהּ; מִכֹּל זֵדִים לְדַעְתָּה׃
verses.english: How far from the wicked is Her word, from all haughty men to know Her.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה עֵינֵי יהוה; עַל־טוֹבִים תַּחְמֹל׃
verses.english: Behold the eyes of the LORD are compassionate over the good ones.

verses.hebrew: וְעַל מְפַאֲרָיו יִגְדַּל חַסְדּוֹ; מֵעֵת רָעָה יַצִּיל נַפְשָׁם׃
verses.english: And upon those who glorify Him He increases His mercy; from an evil time will He deliver their soul.

verses.hebrew: בָּרְכוּ אֶת־יהוה; גּוֹאֵל עָנִי מִיָּד צָרִים; וּמַצִּיל‎ תְּמִימִים‎ מִיָּד רְשָׁעִים׃
verses.english: Bless the LORD, who redeems the humble from the hand of adversaries, and He delivers the perfect from the power of the wicked.

verses.hebrew: מֵקִים קֶרֶן מִיַעֲקֹב; וְשׁוֹפֵט עַמִּים מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Who establishes a horn out of Jacob, and a judge of peoples out of Israel.

verses.hebrew: אִוָּה מִשְׁכָּנוֹ בְּצִיּוֹן; בּוֹחֵר לַנֶצָח בִּירוּשָׁלָיִם׃
verses.english: He who desires his habitation in Zion, choose Jerusalem forever.
